BallMtaani
Kenyan football intelligence platform with live scores, fixtures, standings, fan debates, predictions, and World Cup 2026 tracking.

Primary URL: https://ballmtaani.com/
Coverage: Football only.
Primary audience: Kenyan fans first, global fans second.

Key sections:
- Live Hub: https://ballmtaani.com/
- Home feed: https://ballmtaani.com/home
- Matches data center: https://ballmtaani.com/matches
- Live center: https://ballmtaani.com/live-center
- WC26 tracker: https://ballmtaani.com/world-cup-2026
- Mchambuzi Halisi analyst: https://ballmtaani.com/mchambuzi-halisi
- Market watch: https://ballmtaani.com/market-watch
- Predictions: https://ballmtaani.com/predictions
- Debates: https://ballmtaani.com/debates
- Rapid fire: https://ballmtaani.com/rapid-fire
- Rivalries: https://ballmtaani.com/rivalries
- Fan zones: https://ballmtaani.com/fan-zones
- Trivia: https://ballmtaani.com/trivia
- War room: https://ballmtaani.com/war-room

Freshness:
- Live and fixture context is powered by API-Football.
- News context includes BBC Sport and Goal.com feeds where available.

Editorial intent:
- Fan-first tone.
- Data-backed football commentary.
- No betting-first framing.
